question: Which diabetes products change preferred status on NY Medicaid on 10/22/2026?
assumption: Assuming NY Medicaid (NYRx PDL, effective-date markers); "diabetes products" includes insulin and glucagon. Searched the PDL text, not exhaustively by every class.
answer:
Assuming NY Medicaid, as of today (10/17/2026) none of these changes are in effect yet. All take effect 10/22/2026:

| Product | Status as of 10/22/2026 |
|---|---|
| Humalog® 100 U/mL vial, pen, cartridge | Preferred |
| Humalog® Jr. Kwikpen | Preferred |
| Insulin aspart (gen Novolog®) cartridge, vial, pen | Non-preferred |
| Glucagon HCl emergency kit | Preferred |
| Gvoke® pen, syringe, vial | Preferred |

The GLP-1 and SGLT2 classes show no 10/22 markers in the rows I retrieved. I didn't find markers in other diabetes classes, but I didn't check every class.
